description: This file defines a custom React hook named useApi, which manages API calls including loading, error, data, and retry logic. It exports the hook and a utility function normalizeError for error normalization.

methods.name: useApi(asyncFnOrFactory, deps = [], { auto = true, initialData = null } = {})
methods.description: A React hook to perform API calls with managed loading, error, data, and retry states. Supports auto-invoke and initial data.

methods.name: normalizeError(e)
methods.description: Converts various error objects into a standardized error object with message, status, and data properties.
